summary: All three CT-1 conditions hold. (1) obs_01 (front, left) and obs_02 (front, right) show the same jagged vertical line at the same position and shape, which rules out a shadow. (2) obs_03 (oblique_low) has surface_discontinuity=true, with a bright edge along the line. (3) obs_04 is the approved reference with no line at that location. PROC-CT-002 does not apply: this is a single dominant jagged line, not a cobweb crazing network, and it points to CT-1 anyway. PROC-CT-003 would classify a line as a crack after one lighting change, which is less demanding than CT-1. Where they conflict I prefer the more demanding CT-1, whose conditions are met, so PROC-CT-003 is not what decides the outcome. Its 'straight horizontal line' scenario also does not match this jagged vertical line. Outcome: suspected defect.
